D 4775 Anonymous LETTER DENOUNCING
19.4.33 ONE ZEE PAO; TEACHER OF BEING
COMMUNIST

Form No. 3
G. 25,000-1-33

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. S. B. REGISTRY
No. ) 4775
Bubblingwell Station,
Dat. 19-4-33
Date: April 19, 1933）

Subject (in full)........Anonymous letter denouncing a "Communist"....................................................

Made by....D.S.I. Widdowson....................Forwarded by....[签名]............................................................

Sir,
The attached letter was received at Gordon Road Station on
the 18-4-33, and forwarded to Bubblingwell because it refers to an
address in this district.
The writer denounces one named Zee Pao (錢鏄) said to be
a teacher in the Middle School for Overseas Chinese, as a Communist.
The school is situated at No. 105 Seymour Road, but no enquiries have
been made, as it is considered that the Special Branch may prefer to
handle the matter.

Widdowson.
D.S.I.

A.C. Special Branch.

SI, for comment please.
[签名]
19 IV 33

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. 1, Special Branch Station,
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE. S.1. No. 4775. Date 24.4.33）

Subject (in full) Reference the attached anonymous letter denouncing
one Zee Pao, teacher, as being a Communist

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by Thos Robertson Supt

a neighbourhood
where squabbles
are never
ending
J.R. -

Careful enquiries have been made into allegations
contained in the attached letter signed, "The Reporter"
and forwarded under report by Bubbling Well Station,
resulting in the following information being obtained.
Zee Pao (錢鏞) native of Chekiang, aged about
28, residing at No.111 Tai Wai Fang, Annam Road has been
a teacher of geography at the Chiao Kwang Middle School,
No.103 Seymour Road, formerly the China Overseas Middle
School, for the past 3 years, and in addition teaches
geography at the Kwong Hwa Middle School, Great Western
Road. He is married and has two children who reside
with him at the above address. Among his associates
and friends he has the reputation of being a quiet, studious
person and devoted to his family.
No confirmation can be obtained of the paragraph
referring to his supposed or suggested misconduct with
female pupils of the school.

E.M. Golder
D. S. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
